response.sql: SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageListPrice, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond FROM Track AS t INNER JOIN MediaType AS m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
